confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate from general knowledge of Tel Aviv prices for July 2026; no live menus, listings or booking pages were checked. Restaurant and coffee anchors are moderately certain; hostel and hotel anchors are least certain given seasonal, security-news and currency swings. Cocktail and wine anchors were set relative to the beer anchor using typical local bar and restaurant price relationships because direct knowledge is weaker. FX value is from RBA pages as indexed by web search, not a live feed.
comparable_city_reasoning: No single comparable city was used. Regional basis: Eastern Mediterranean coastal city with high local costs. Food and drink anchors reflect general knowledge of local shekel price levels translated to USD; accommodation anchors reflect general knowledge of peak-summer rates in high-cost Mediterranean coastal cities.
